Explicit native reductions (all native-safe, visual-intent-preserving; no behaviour/state/API-path/unit/i18n drift): (1) react-i18next -> useNativeTranslation fallback shim (keys + English defaults verbatim); (2) framer-motion FadeIn -> Animated entry with reduce-motion respect (delay 0.24s preserved); (3) Recharts AreaChart + Area + XAxis/YAxis/CartesianGrid + Tooltip + Legend + ReferenceLine + ChartGradient + AREA_DEFAULTS -> the native AreaChartWrapper area renderer (translucent #00f0ff fill, grid, time/value axes, latest-value legend) plus ChartContainer's accessible data table for exact values; (4) ChartContainer wrapper props mapped 1:1. Torque is in Nm (already SI / not a user-preference unit), so no unit conversion is involved — matching the web, which performs none. The ./constants MotorChartDataPoint type is mirrored locally because the native constants module is not ported yet.

No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, recharts, leaflet, framer-motion, or old web @/components/ui imports appear in the native output — only react, react-native (AccessibilityInfo, Animated, Easing), and the native parity charts barrel (ChartContainer, AreaChartWrapper).
